_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change goals-linked-to-decisions (REQ-010). A decision can name the organisation goal it serves. Optional and nullable, so a decision without a goal stays valid; the goal's linkedDecisionCount aggregation (66-organisation-goals.json) counts decisions through this reference. A property only, so no schema version moves here: a later fragment in the merge order sets the decision's version and a lower one here would be overwritten anyway.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: The organisation goal this decision serves. Empty when the decision serves no goal.
